description: A patient is composed of one or more laboratory panels; a panel cannot exist without its patient record.
A patient is composed of one or more examination records; an examination cannot exist without its patient record. Only part of the examination identifiers resolve in practice.

connection_condition: age is computed from the birth year in tab02.fld015
description: Age is derived as the current calendar year minus the year of birth; no stored age column exists.

connection_condition: tab02.fld008 and tab01.fld008 hold comparable diagnosis labels for the same patient, with different grain
description: The patient-level diagnosis is a consolidated label while the examination-level diagnosis describes a single visit; labels agree modulo case and encoding for shared patients, and the examination label may add visit-specific findings.

connection_condition: tab01.fld008 belongs to the same row as the examination
description: Each examination record may carry its own visit-level diagnosis alongside the ANA, thrombosis and symptom fields.

connection_condition: both recorded in the same examination row (tab01.fld005 and tab01.fld006)
description: ANA titer and ANA pattern are two components of the same antinuclear antibody result; a titer can be present without a pattern but never the reverse.

connection_condition: both recorded in the same examination row (tab01.fld013 and tab01.fld009-fld011)
description: Thrombosis level and the coagulation flags both describe thrombotic/coagulation status of the same examination, with the level being an ordinal summary.
